summary: Outlook Therapeutics filed an 8-K to announce FDA approval of its biologics license application for ONS-5010/LYTENAVA (bevacizumab-vikg) for wet AMD. The filing is a routine regulatory milestone press release, not a special situation. No transaction, activist, strategic review, or structural change is disclosed. The company expects 12 years of market exclusivity under the BPCIA. No financial terms, premiums, or deal mechanics are provided.
